notes: Budget: 8 of 8 searches used, 19 fetches. Known shows skipped: Northeast Sports Card Expo Quincy (matches known list, Nov 21 to 22, not re-researched), SCG CON Hartford, Woonsocket, Best Flippin' items, Woburn and Central Mass mixers, Harvard, Portland ME 2027, Boston 2027 and TCG Boston 2026. Norwalk series: source is the Post's own 2026 schedule page, which is undated (URL dated 2025/02/15) and does not state admission, table prices or table counts, so those are omitted; a search summary quoted $3 entry and $40/$45 tables but no fetched page confirmed it. Norwalk listing page on localcardshows says 'Check with venue' for admission. Maine leads without listing URLs (year not shown on the page): L/A Collectibles Show at Pleasant Street Bingo in Lewiston (June 7), Mainely Card Show in Sanford (May 23 to 24), House of Cards and Collectibles in Westbrook (June 13). Sources for those are treasurehunter.show only. Rhode Island: no November 2026 card show found in the region apart from a comic con (out of scope). Vermont: no Essex card show found, Essex comics convention is not a card show. New Hampshire: Manchester, Nashua and Portsmouth 2026 shows are past. Pages that returned 403 or 404 are in blocked; no bypass was tried. Past Lowell MA (June 7 2026) and Springfield MA (Sept 20 2026) shows were not recorded for lack of size. The Chicopee series is not confirmed as monthly. Organizer pages for Milford CT, Dover NH, Leominster MA, Wakefield MA and Somersworth NH were not found, so those stay as leads. Only organizer or venue facts were used for the Norwalk, EC3CON and Post 12 entries; the Rutland, Bath and Springfield entries rest on a calendar or a listing site (medium confidence). Quincy, Boston and Portland ME 2027 items are known and were skipped.
